Cookies are small files a website can store in your browser. This page explains how this website, operated by Sthitha Quantum Innovations Pvt Ltd, uses them.

Cookies We Set

This website uses the Meta Pixel for advertising measurement, described below. Apart from that, we do not use analytics cookies, and we do not set cookies of our own for tracking.

Third-Party Services

Meta Pixel (all pages). We use the Meta Pixel, a tool provided by Meta Platforms, Inc., to measure the performance of our advertising and to show relevant ads on Facebook and Instagram. When a page loads, the Pixel may set cookies (such as _fbp) and send Meta information such as the page you viewed, your IP address, and your browser and device details. This lets Meta recognise visitors across its platforms. Meta handles this data under its own Privacy Policy and Cookies Policy. You can control ad personalisation in your Meta ad preferences.

Google reCAPTCHA (Contact page only). The contact form uses Google reCAPTCHA to prevent spam and abuse. When the Contact page loads, Google may set cookies and read information from your browser, such as your IP address, device and browser details, and how you interact with the page. This is handled by Google under its own Privacy Policy and Terms of Service. reCAPTCHA is used only to protect the form and is not loaded on other pages.

EmailJS (Contact page only). When you submit the contact form, your message is sent through EmailJS to our inbox. EmailJS does not set cookies on this website for this purpose. See the Privacy Policy for how your details are handled.

Google Fonts. The website loads some typefaces from Google Fonts, which means your browser makes a request to Google when a page loads.

Other sites. Links to third-party sites such as Udemy take you to websites that set their own cookies under their own policies.

Managing Cookies

You can block or delete cookies through your browser settings. Blocking cookies should not affect how most of this website works. Browser extensions that block trackers will also stop the Meta Pixel from loading. If you block Google reCAPTCHA, the contact form cannot be submitted, and you can email us directly instead.

Changes

If we introduce further analytics or other non-essential cookies in future, we will update this page first and, where required, ask for your consent.

Contact

Questions about this policy can be sent to sthithaquantuminnovations@gmail.com. See also our Privacy Policy.
